basic_info.description: Unbeatable Investment Opportunity!!!  This vacant single-family residence, complete with a full-size basement and bonus cottage, offers endless potential for savvy investors or homeowners.  Whether you're looking for strong cash flow or a prime flip opportunity, this property delivers.  Each unit features 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, with the potential to create two full studios in the basement for additional income.  Situated in a highly desirable location with proximity to UCSF Mount Zion, Kaiser on Geary, boutique shops, fine dining, parks, and public transit.  Enjoy a short stroll to the vibrant Fillmore Street, Divisadero Street, and Japantown, with convenient access to everything the city has to offer.  Don't miss out on this rare chance to own a versatile property in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods!
